notes: Edit this file to adapt the tool to another system. No code change required.

application.name: BulkSuppliers Supplier Sync
application.description: Worker that syncs supplier details, addresses and contacts from Aldavar to Galileo via the ALD SAT gateway.

throughput_baseline.derived_from: 39 address records completed in 7s at 11:03 on 2026-08-18
throughput_baseline.note: Used only when the pasted log contains no successful batch to derive a rate from.

redaction._comment: Applied to the stage 7 prompt only, before it leaves the machine. Identifiers are swapped for tokens and swapped back in the reply, so the model never receives a real hostname, IP, incident id or team name. System and layer names (Galileo, Aldavar, BulkSuppliers) are NOT redacted - stripping them would leave a prompt too generic to write from. Claim the narrow thing accurately.

precedent._comment: Similarity backend for precedent.py. 'embeddings' does cosine over the NORMALISED SIGNATURE only (never a raw stack trace), calibrated by embeddings.SIMILARITY_FLOOR, and falls back to 'lexical' automatically if the key or network is missing. 'lexical' is deterministic Dice-coefficient matching and needs nothing. Override with INVESTIGATOR_PRECEDENT_BACKEND; the test suite pins lexical so it stays offline and reproducible.

client_timeout_note: .NET HttpClient default. An elapsed time well below this rules the client out as the cutter.

known_ceilings.typical_owner: API gateway / reverse proxy / load balancer
known_ceilings.note: A round-number cutoff that no application configures by accident.
